panel-title.purpose: Shape library and contextual property headings.

body.purpose: Regular editor content and property values.

metadata.purpose: Source revision, save status, hints, and counts.

motion.name: connection-handle-reveal
motion.purpose: Reveal ports during hover, selection, and keyboard focus; connection tasks keep ports visible.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Shared command feedback; pressed feedback has no transition delay and reduced-motion removes transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Commit a local editor action such as adding a connection.
components.css: .ds-primary { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--diagram-primary, #0071e3); color: var(--diagram-on-primary, #ffffff); } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--diagram-primary-hover, #0066cc); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--diagram-accent, #0a84ff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-primary:active { opacity: .75; transition-duration: 0ms; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: .38; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet toolbar action; the pressed state identifies an active tool.
components.css: .ds-ghost { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); padding: 0 10px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--diagram-secondary, #d1d1d6); } .ds-ghost:hover { background: var(--diagram-hover, #ffffff0c); } .ds-ghost[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--diagram-selected, #16375b); color: var(--diagram-accent-text, #7bb7ff); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--diagram-accent, #0a84ff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-ghost:active { background: var(--diagram-active, #48484a); opacity: .75; transition-duration: 0ms; } .ds-ghost:disabled { opacity: .38; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-ghost { transition: none; } }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Secondary document action such as exporting or duplicating a shape.
components.css: .ds-outline { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); background: var(--diagram-surface, #2c2c2e); color: var(--diagram-secondary, #d1d1d6); border: 1px solid var(--diagram-control-line, #636369); } .ds-outline:hover { border-color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground, 240 4% 68%) / .5); } .ds-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--diagram-accent, #0a84ff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-outline:active { opacity: .75; transition-duration: 0ms; } .ds-outline:disabled { opacity: .38; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-outline { transition: none; } }

components.name: Property Field
components.description: Theme-aware inspector field for editable dimensions and diagram properties.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; width: 148px; margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--diagram-secondary, #d1d1d6); font: 500 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; } .ds-field-label span { color: var(--diagram-muted, #aaaab1); font-size: 10px; } .ds-field { width: 148px; height: 38px; border: 1px solid var(--diagram-control-line, #636369); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 16px; background: var(--diagram-field, #323235); color: var(--diagram-text, #f5f5f7); font: 400 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; box-shadow: none; caret-color: var(--diagram-accent, #0a84ff); } .ds-field:hover { border-color: hsl(210 100% 45% / .35); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--diagram-accent, #0a84ff); outline-offset: -2px; border-color: hsl(210 100% 45% / .7); } .ds-field:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-field { font-size: 16px; } }

components.name: Command Bar
components.description: Grouped document commands above the drawing canvas.
components.css: .ds-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 49px; padding: 2px 8px; background: var(--diagram-chrome, #242426); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--diagram-line, #454548); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; } .ds-toolbar-group { padding-right: 6px; border-right: 1px solid var(--diagram-line, #454548); } .ds-toolbar button { min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--diagram-secondary, #d1d1d6); font: 500 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toolbar button:hover { background: var(--diagram-hover, #ffffff0c); } .ds-toolbar button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--diagram-accent, #0a84ff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-toolbar button:active { background: var(--diagram-active, #48484a); opacity: .75; } .ds-toolbar .ds-toolbar-active { background: var(--diagram-selected, #16375b); color: var(--diagram-accent-text, #7bb7ff); } @media (max-width: 1050px) { .ds-toolbar { overflow-x: auto; } }

components.name: Shape Card
components.description: A labelled library shape that can be clicked or dragged into the canvas.
components.css: .ds-shape { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; width: 72px; height: 88px; padding: 10px 4px; border: 1px solid var(--diagram-line, #454548); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--diagram-surface, #2c2c2e); color: var(--diagram-secondary, #d1d1d6); font: 400 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-shape:hover { background: var(--diagram-selected, #16375b); border-color: var(--diagram-accent, #0a84ff); } .ds-shape:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--diagram-accent, #0a84ff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-shape:active { opacity: .75; } .ds-shape:disabled { opacity: .38; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-shape { width: auto; height: 48px; padding: 4px; flex-direction: row; gap: 5px; border: 0; font-size: 11px; } .ds-shape svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; } }

components.name: Saved Document Card
components.description: Open an account-local document from the saved-document dialog.
components.css: .ds-saved { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 68px; padding: 12px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(var(--secondary, 240 3% 20%)); color: var(--diagram-text, #f5f5f7); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-saved:hover { border-color: hsl(210 100% 45%); } .ds-saved:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(210 100% 45%); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-saved:active { opacity: .75; } .ds-saved:disabled { opacity: .5; } .ds-saved > svg { flex-shrink: 0; color: hsl(210 100% 45%); } .ds-saved > span:not(.ds-saved-check) { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; } .ds-saved strong { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-saved small { font-size: 11px; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground, 240 4% 68%)); } .ds-saved-check { color: hsl(210 100% 45%); }

components.name: Selection Chip
components.description: Theme-aware passive text feedback for the selected object or active connection task.
components.css: .ds-selection-chip { display: inline-block; color: var(--diagram-accent-text, #7bb7ff); background: var(--diagram-selected, #16375b); border: 1px solid var(--diagram-selected-line, #325b89); border-radius: 4px; padding: 5px 8px; font: 400 11px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; pointer-events: none; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-selection-chip { font-size: 10px; } }

narrative.overview:
The editor pairs the familiar draw.io workbench arrangement with Apple-inspired graphite colors by default and a complete light variant. A quiet neutral frame holds the document controls, shape library, and status tools around the drawing surface. Blue identifies actions, focus, and selection while the drawing itself remains the main content.

This record applies only to the diagram editor, its menus, and its saved-document and deletion dialogs. The surrounding AutoCheck website keeps its incumbent design. The record follows the implemented component and stylesheet rather than prescribing a new website identity.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite canvas and tools by default, with a complete light variant.
Compact system typography and explicit control labels.
A persistent shape library with contextual editing properties.
Direct movement, drag-to-draw arrows, visible connection handles, and reversible edits.
Responsive tools that keep the drawing workspace usable on narrow screens.

rules.name: The Scoped Color Rule
rules.body: Apply the same `data-diagram-theme` to the editor and its portaled menus and dialogs; preserve the surrounding site's colors.

rules.name: The Contextual Properties Rule
rules.body: Reserve the inspector for the selected object or active connection task so the unselected canvas receives the available width.

dos: **Do** preserve the shape-library, canvas, and contextual-inspector arrangement.
**Do** use blue for actions, focus, and active editor controls while neutral surfaces carry structure.
**Do** theme portaled editor menus and dialogs alongside the embedded editor.
**Do** keep both canvas appearances legible with mode-aware drawing-color helpers and preserve the white page for portable exports.
**Do** retain visible saved-state feedback and separate editable JSON backup instructions.
donts: **Don't** apply this scoped editor palette to the surrounding AutoCheck website.
**Don't** make the inspector a permanent empty column when there is no selected object or active connection task.
**Don't** rely on color alone for selected swatches, current saved documents, or disabled editing capability.
**Don't** remove the narrow-screen property pane or accessible command names when simplifying the toolbar.
**Don't** persist appearance preferences or invisible canvas endpoint helpers inside diagram documents.
